**Description**
 Amazon Advertising is a multi\-billion\-dollar business and one of the fastest\-growing at Amazon. The Autonomous Development team within Ads AI Core Infra (ACI) org is reinventing how advertising software gets built: we develop AI agents and developer\-intelligence systems that write, review, and ship production code across the Ads org. If you want to work at the frontier of agentic software development — where large language models do the implementation and engineers design the systems that make them correct, safe, and scalable — this is the team.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to build the platforms behind autonomous software delivery. Our systems already index tens of thousands of software pipelines to give engineers and AI agents grounded, up\-to\-date answers about how Amazon's code actually works; they generate code changes directly from feature specifications; and they take real engineering intake from partner teams and deliver working, reviewed code with minimal human involvement. You will design the services, data platforms, and evaluation infrastructure that let these agents operate reliably at Amazon scale.
   

  

 This is high\-ownership, high\-impact work. The problems span distributed systems, large\-scale data and retrieval, LLM orchestration, and the evaluation frameworks that let us trust autonomous output enough to ship it. You will build systems that thousands of builders depend on every week, and your work will directly move how fast the entire Ads org can turn an idea into shipped software.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and operate large\-scale distributed services that power AI agents and developer\-intelligence systems used across the Ads organization
* Build retrieval and indexing platforms that keep AI agents grounded in how Amazon's code and systems actually work, refreshed continuously and at scale
* Develop agentic code\-generation systems that turn specifications into reviewed, production\-ready code changes
* Build the evaluation and quality infrastructure that measures agent correctness and gives engineers the confidence to ship autonomous output
* Drive technical design for ambiguous, greenfield problems and raise the engineering bar through design and code reviews
* Partner with applied scientists and other engineering teams to take AI capabilities from prototype to reliable, monitored production systems
* Own operational excellence — reliability, latency, cost, and observability for systems running 24/7


 A day in the life
   

  

* Design and implement features for our agentic development and code\-intelligence platforms
* Debug and optimize distributed systems and retrieval pipelines for correctness, latency, and cost
* Build and review evaluations that quantify how well our agents perform on real engineering work
* Collaborate with engineers and applied scientists across Ads to integrate and scale AI capabilities
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and architectural deep\-dives
* Mentor other engineers and help raise the team's technical bar


**About The Team**
 We are the Autonomous Development team within the Ads AI Core Infra (ACI) organization at Amazon Advertising. Our mission is simple to state and hard to do: change how advertising software gets built, so that an idea can become shipped, production\-quality code faster than ever before. We build the agents and developer\-intelligence platforms that the rest of the Ads org relies on to move quickly and correctly.
   

  

 We operate at the frontier of agentic software development, where large language models do the implementation and engineers design the systems that make that output correct, safe, and scalable. We figure it out, build it, and put it in front of thousands of builders.

Mapbox is the leading real\-time location platform for a new generation of location\-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Search Box \- Offline Search team is responsible for building a robust, high\-performance search engine that empowers mobile and automotive customers to find places, addresses, and points of interest seamlessly, even in environments with zero network connectivity. We do this by engineering highly optimized on\-device search algorithms, developing advanced data compression and efficient delta update mechanisms, and creating lightweight, scalable tile\-based solutions that deliver low\-latency results on constrained hardware. Our work ensures that users—from drivers navigating remote highways to mobile users in dense urban dead zones—experience a reliable, fast, and consistent search experience wherever they go.
   

  

 As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision\-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Joining us as a Software Engineer on the Offline Search team, you will play a critical role in bringing world\-class search capabilities to embedded systems and mobile devices operating without network connectivity. You will bring your expertise in systems engineering and performance optimization to a passionate, cross\-functional team focused on the automotive and mobile mapping space.
   

  

* Design, code, and optimize core search algorithms tailored for on\-device execution, ensuring high\-speed query resolution under strict CPU, memory, and storage constraints.
* Take ownership of complex offline data delivery systems, designing and implementing advanced tile compression techniques (e.g., Zstd) and efficient delta update pipelines to minimize payload sizes.
* Collaborate across multiple R\&D and backend teams to seamlessly integrate data processing pipelines and ensure parity between our cloud and offline search products.
* Engage directly with trend\-setting automotive OEMs in EU, US, Japan, and China, as well as suppliers like automotive Tier 1 companies and Mapping firms to understand hardware specifications, troubleshoot integration challenges, and align technical deliverables with their rollout schedules.
* Collect and monitor deep system telemetry to evaluate performance tradeoffs (e.g., CPU utilization vs. query latency), establish baselines, and drive continuous architectural improvements.
* Play a key role in defining the technical roadmap, scoping complex features, and writing technical design documents for next\-generation offline search capabilities.


**What We Believe Are Important Traits For This Role**
* You are located in the Eastern Time Zone.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong proficiency in C\+\+ (our core engine language), with a solid understanding of memory management, multi\-threading, and systems\-level programming.
* Experience with Python or other scripting languages commonly used for tooling, data processing, or test automation.
* Proven experience analyzing and optimizing code for performance\-constrained environments, thoughtfully balancing tradeoffs between CPU utilization, memory consumption, and query latency.
* Familiarity with data structures, algorithmic efficiency, and binary data formats (experience with data compression like Zstd or delta update mechanisms is a strong plus).
* Strong analytical thinking and the ability to justify technical decisions using system telemetry and data.
* Meticulous attention to detail and a creative, resourceful approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent communication skills in English, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional engineering, product, and data teams.


**Nice to Have Traits for This Role**
* Prior experience in the mapping, navigation, or automotive industry.
* Knowledge of machine learning techniques for geospatial data analysis.
* Contributions to open\-source geospatial or data analysis projects.
